name: Tyrol
summary: White over red with the state arms: a red eagle with gold claws and a green wreath (the Ehrenkranz) on white.
origin: The red Tyrolean eagle dates from the 13th century, the arms of the Counts of Tyrol. The green wreath was granted in 1416.

symbols.name: Tyrolean eagle
symbols.description: A red eagle with a green wreath on its wings.

facts: The Tyrolean eagle is also used by South Tyrol in Italy.
clues: White over red with a red eagle wearing a green wreath.
Its eagle is shared with a province across the Italian border.
